issue.title: Bank — acknowledge every transaction daily, prove it weekly
issue.description: Bryan restarts his daily bank habit right away. Every posted transaction and deposit becomes one checkbox row in a monthly bank note under a new `bank` sub-area of `cash`. Typing a row acknowledges it. A weekly `bob bank import` of a Wells Fargo QFX file writes, unchecked, only the rows he missed, and a balance proof shows that nothing was skipped. Every total is computed when it is drawn (terminal, month card, queue card, daily chip) and never written into notes. A missed week costs one sitting to catch up, not a retyping spiral.

payload.entry: DISCOVERED ISSUE: bob bank ensure (month::plan_insert_day → day_end_line, src/native/bank/month.rs:300) inserts a new day heading right after the previous day's last row block (row + indented children), not at the end of that day's section. Any trailing non-row line of the earlier day — free prose, a plain checklist line, or an empty '- [x] $' stub — is silently moved under the new day; bob bank check reports nothing, and ensure's next-row line then points at the moved line. Repro (synthetic, installed bob 0.5.0 @ 2026-11-11): BOB_NOW=2026-11-12T08:00:00; bob bank ensure -b SB -D 2026-11-11; append '- [x] $13.71 Smashburger', '  - split with Kelly', 'Kelly paid the tip in cash.', '- [ ] call the bank about the fee' under ## Wed Nov 11; bob bank ensure -b SB -D 2026-11-12 → '## Thu Nov 12' lands after the child bullet and the prose + checklist lines now sit under Thu. Contract (docs/bank.md 'Writers insert a missing day heading in date order') implies the day's whole section stays intact. Impact: Bank: open today, the daily-chip ensure, and any import path that reuses plan_insert_day can re-date Bryan's notes. Suggested fix: anchor the insert before the next day heading / at the end of the earlier day's section (trimming trailing blanks), plus a golden test with trailing prose, a plain checklist line, and a stub.
